problem: Completed Pico JPEG was discarded when the next partial TCP frame arrived before USB publication.
fix: One completed slot and one in-progress slot; swap bytes and metadata only on frame completion. No JPEG queue.
measurement_budget: Each raw-stream run stops after 25 seconds or 150 frames, whichever comes first.
conditions: Same powered camera and target, 320x240 JPEG, same laptop HTTP client and original detector. Dashboard detection OFF during the four raw-stream runs.

attempts.change: Preserve the complete JPEG through partial next-frame input.
attempts.result: 4.434/6.604 to 12.904/13.300 fps; p95 gaps 640/515 to 187/141 ms; zero gaps over 400 ms in both updated runs.
attempts.reason: Both updated runs exceed baseline variation; all CRC and correctness checks pass.

confirmation_scope: Unmodified BlueSquare replayed on locally captured JPEGs at original arrival times; every raw-run frame had a candidate. Updated runs stay confirmed after the first three distinct frames.
live_worker_scope: Separate DetectionVideo worker consumes the live raw HTTP stream with on_observation=None; GET requests only. Other user-controlled dashboard clients are not disabled or altered.

installation.method: Built UF2 copied to identity-checked newly appeared RPI-RP2 boot volume; board rebooted and V3 identity/live stream verified.

privacy: Raw bench JPEGs remain only in ignored local work; Git contains aggregate metrics and source, no private network configuration or compiled firmware.
limits: Measured frame gaps and USB-receipt-to-local-HTTP age. Camera exposure-to-display latency and physical target stopping distance were not measured. Lighting, target shape/motion and radio conditions still affect results.
